Titman-Wei-Xie 2004 capex; q-theory rationalizes as risk-based discount-rate mechanism.
Cooper-Gulen-Schill 2008; modern q-theory interpretation as investment risk premium.
Sloan 1996; canonical limits-to-arbitrage mispricing -- accrual persistence misjudged.
Xie 2001 residual accruals; Sloan extension -- mispricing of discretionary component.
Frazzini-Pedersen 2014 BAB; leverage-constraint mechanism producing risk-priced low-beta premium.

Piotroski 2000 F-score; fundamental signal not arbitraged among value stocks -- mispricing.
Foster-Olsen-Shevlin 1984 PEAD; canonical underreaction to earnings news.
Bradshaw-Richardson-Sloan 2006; issuance signals overvaluation; LTA prevents arbitrage.
Daniel-Titman 2006 long-horizon issuance; mispricing-driven managerial timing.
Banz 1981; canonical Fama-French interpretation as distress-risk premium.
Novy-Marx 2013 gross profitability; expected-profitability discount-rate mechanism.
Bali-Cakici-Whitelaw 2011 lottery preferences; investor preference for skewness -- behavioral.
